rules: .runtime-status { display: block; overflow: hidden; color: var(--sim-ink); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 720; line-height: 1.25; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.runtime-status { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; margin: -1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0px, 0px, 0px, 0px); clip-path: inset(50%); white-space: nowrap; }
.sim-app .simulation-toolbar #runtime-status { display: inline; max-width: none; white-space: normal; }

.status-pill { display: flex; min-height: var(--sim-touch-target); max-width: 100%; align-items: center; gap: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--sim-line-strong); padding: 0px 14px; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: transform var(--sim-motion-fast) var(--sim-ease), box-shadow var(--sim-motion-fast) ease; }
.status-pill { position: relative; width: var(--sim-touch-target); min-width: var(--sim-touch-target); min-height: var(--sim-touch-target); justify-content: center; padding: 0px; }
.runtime-toolbar { display: flex; max-width: 100%; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
.sim-app .runtime-toolbar { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-width: 0px; }
.runtime-anchor { position: fixed; z-index: 20; top: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-top)); left: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-left)); max-width: min(520px, -32px + 100vw); }
.runtime-anchor { top: max(10px, env(safe-area-inset-top)); right: max(10px, env(safe-area-inset-right)); left: max(10px, env(safe-area-inset-left)); max-width: none; }

body.sim-app .runtime-anchor { position: relative; inset: auto; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; width: 100%; max-width: none; padding: 0px; background: transparent; border: 0px; box-shadow: none; }
body.sim-app .simulation-stage { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0px, 1fr); gap: 12px; height: auto; }
body.sim-app .map-workspace { width: min(1440px, 100%); height: auto; margin-inline: auto; padding: 20px 24px 40px; }
html, body { width: 100%; min-width: 320px; height: 100%; margin: 0px; overflow: hidden; }
